cases.purpose: Run the pinned authority control packet for the privileged-command device, request binding, audit decoding and the auth, doas and sudo command consumers against the production module and device node, loaded without a qualification gate, with every consumer invoked without a qualification flag.
cases.oracle: The written authority contracts as encoded by the pinned packet driver: independent wire layouts and request digests, an independent Argon2 library, kernel audit records, live credential and filesystem observations. The transport independently requires the exact pinned control inventory, every control PASS, an unchanged input set, no new kernel warning or taint, and no authority module or node before or after.
cases.comparison: All 19 controls of the pinned inventory must pass on the production endpoint; the receipt binds every module, native program and driver by SHA-256 and is itself bound to the build tool receipt.
